value.deck: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) team publishes a new roadmap outlining planned features and directions for the open standard that enables AI models to interact with external tools and data sources.
shortVersion: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) team publishes a new roadmap outlining planned features and directions for the open standard that enables AI models to interact with external tools and data sources.
MCP is rapidly becoming the standard integration layer for AI agent tooling; the roadmap shapes what developers can rely on and build toward in their AI-powered applications.
